findings.title: Missing findings can pass the gate
findings.description: `gateVerdict` substitutes an empty array when `read.findings` is absent or null and never compares it with `finding_count`. A parseable Qodo response claiming three findings but containing `findings: null` or `findings: []` can therefore return `done` for a completed review, bypassing every finding the read failed to supply.

citations.citation:
`qodo read pr-review-session findings --pr-url <PR_URL> --json` returns:

- `review_session` — the latest review run: `status`, `commit_sha` (**the last commit included in
  the review** — the code these findings describe), `started_at`. **`null` = the PR has no review
  yet** — tell the user and stop (nothing to resolve).
- `findings[]` — every current finding, each with: `id`, `title`, `description`, `category`,
  `action_level` (`action_required` > `remediation_recommended` > `informational`),
  `attribution_status`, `git_sha`, `location` (`file_path`, `start_line`, `end_line`, `side`),
  and `evidence.citations` (each citation's `source_type` and `source`). This is the same default
  Finding object used by local reviews. Unavailable locations or evidence are null.
  Use the location to inspect the affected code and the stable ID to record an authorized outcome.
  Provider comment IDs, internal reviewer decisions, and fix instructions are excluded in both modes.

Zero findings supports a clean verdict only for a complete, completed review at the current PR head.

findings.title: Low-only reviews skip the gate report
findings.description: `continueRun` marks a Low-only review done before calling `writeReview` or running the agent's review step. When no High or Medium is open, the owner receives only Low titles and severities, while the required gate report with each Low's type and reason is never produced.

citations.citation:
**Fix:** every **valid High or Medium** finding, of any type, test first (step 7).
**Flag, don't fix:** every **Low** finding. List each one under **Low findings for jtbinith** in your report, with its type and why it matters. Leave Low rule violations unchanged.

**Valid** means you reproduced it against the code and the ticket: a failing test or a run with its output. If a High or Medium isn't valid, don't fix it and don't treat it as closed: give the evidence in your report. It stays open until jtbinith dismisses it in Qodo.

**Not done** if any of these is true. Report the task as NOT DONE and say exactly what you need:
- a valid High or Medium is still open, or a disputed one hasn't been decided by jtbinith
- a check didn't run or didn't pass (`npm test`, direct and relay)
- the latest **completed** review doesn't cover the final commit. For a PR, its review of the head must be complete: a skipped or partial review doesn't count.
- the final review was a quick or partial one. A local review with `--fast`, or one where Qodo ran only some of its reviewers, is a checkpoint, never the final word: on #89 a quick local pass came back clean and Qodo's PR review then found 2 Mediums.
- the loop stalls: 3 fix rounds, the same finding still open after its fix, or two reviews in a row that find problems your last fix caused (it happened twice on #89)

**Report**, after the last review:
| Finding | Type | Severity | Valid? (evidence) | What you did |
|---|---|---|---|---|

then **Low findings for jtbinith**, then **Gate met: yes / no**, and why.

In an unattended run the runner checks this gate itself, from Qodo's stored review of the PR head (not from your report). It marks the run done only when no High or Medium is open and the review of the head is complete.

evidence.explanation: The work-ticket gate requires every Low to be flagged with its type and why it matters, followed by a gate report. The `done` branch returns before `writeReview` and the review agent run; its `lowsLine` formatter includes only severity and title.

findings.title: Clean reviews can time out
findings.description: `continueRun` calls `gateVerdict` only after `qodoReview` finds a rendered comment naming the head commit. If Qodo's stored review is complete but its GitHub comment is missing or stale, the runner waits until timeout instead of accepting the authoritative review.

findings.title: An unreviewed PR head can be marked done
findings.description: `continueRun` passes the saved `s.head` to `gateVerdict` without comparing it with the PR’s current head on GitHub. If the PR branch is updated outside the runner, the old Qodo comment and stored review can both match `s.head`, so the runner applies `agent-done` to a PR whose new commit was never reviewed.

evidence.explanation: The comment check and new stored-review check use `s.head`; neither reads the live PR head before the new done path labels the ticket complete.

findings.title: Stop comments bury the unfinished status
findings.description: The new gate failures put `NOT DONE` inside the reason passed to `stop()`, but `stop()` prefixes that reason with “Factory run stopped and needs you.” When a review is incomplete or blocking findings remain, the owner’s comment therefore does not start with `NOT DONE` as the gate promises.
